summary: DevRelay is a deterministic source/installable library operated through ChatGPT/Codex Desktop on Windows. PM-001 ProjectMemory is complete and now loads first. EP-001 must add environment preparation and verification through the full released lifecycle without weakening Core authority or the controlled Windows release boundary.
stakeholders: Module, adapter, host, and specialist authors
domainConstraints: ProjectMemory and bounded TraceabilityGraph context load before this lifecycle slice.
Every already-released upstream module must run before EP-001 is appended to the lifecycle.
Core remains provider-neutral and adapters remain untrusted effect proposers.
The release-defining DevRelay host is Windows Desktop, while project-specific target environments require explicit requirements closure.
Environment evidence must be source-preserving, digest-bound, redacted, and replayable.
conventions: Ask clarification questions in breadth-first waves.
Require weighted closure of at least 0.99 and 0.99 confidence for every blocking domain.
Present qualitative additions and replacements before Requirements Gate promotion.
Use exact checkpoints and zero-call replay for effectful preparation.
